name: codex-auto-router
description: Automatic, safety-gated routing of bounded Codex work to native Terra or Luna background agents.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically route safe bounded work to native Codex agents.
interface.longDescription: Considers every Main Task once, applies the repository policy gate, and delegates only safe bounded work to fixed Terra or Luna native-agent tuples while Root retains judgment and final verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Apply the Codex Auto Router policy to the Main Task.
